```
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Windows;
using DotaComboBoard.Models;
using DotaComboBoard.Services;

namespace DotaComboBoard;

public partial class AnalysisWindow : Window
{
    private readonly GeminiAnalysisService _analysisService;
    private readonly DotaAssetResolver _assetResolver = new();
    private readonly LineupAnalysisRequest _lineup;
    private readonly bool _isThai;

    public AnalysisWindow(RowConfig row, GeminiConfig config, bool isThai)
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        _isThai = isThai;
        _lineup = CreateRequest(row);
        _analysisService = new GeminiAnalysisService(config);
        foreach (var pick in _lineup.Picks)
        {
            pick.IconPath = _assetResolver.ResolveHeroPath(pick.Hero);
            pick.RoleDisplay = LocalizeRole(pick.Role);
        }

        ApplyLanguageText();
        LineupItems.ItemsSource = _lineup.Picks;
        Loaded += async (_, _) => await LoadAnalysisAsync(false);
    }

    private async Task LoadAnalysisAsync(bool forceRefresh)
    {
        LoadingPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        ErrorPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        AnalysisTabs.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        ReanalyzeButton.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;

        try
        {
            var analysis = await _analysisService.AnalyzeAsync(_lineup, _isThai ? "Thai" : "English", forceRefresh);
            await _assetResolver.PopulateAnalysisAssetsAsync(analysis, _lineup.Picks);
            ApplyResultLanguage(analysis);
            PatchText.Text = _isThai ? $"แพตช์ {analysis.PatchNumber}" : $"PATCH {analysis.PatchNumber}";
            OverviewText.Text = analysis.Overview;
            LanePhaseText.Text = analysis.PhasePlan.LanePhase;
            TeamFightText.Text = analysis.PhasePlan.TeamFight;
            PickOffText.Text = analysis.PhasePlan.PickOff;
            LosingGameText.Text = analysis.PhasePlan.LosingGame;
            CounterItems.ItemsSource = analysis.CounterHeroes;
            CriticalItems.ItemsSource = analysis.CriticalStages;
            ReplacementItems.ItemsSource = analysis.Replacements;
            Pos1Content.Content = FindRolePlan(analysis, "1", 0);
            Pos2Content.Content = FindRolePlan(analysis, "2", 1);
            Pos5Content.Content = FindRolePlan(analysis, "5", 2);
            LoadingPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            AnalysisTabs.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            ReanalyzeButton.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LoadingPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            ErrorText.Text = _isThai ? $"วิเคราะห์ไม่สำเร็จ: {exception.Message}" : exception.Message;
            ErrorPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        }
    }

    private void ApplyLanguageText()
    {
        Title = _isThai ? "วิเคราะห์ชุดฮีโร่" : "Lineup Analysis";
        HeaderTitleText.Text = _isThai ? "วิเคราะห์ทีม" : "LINEUP INTELLIGENCE";
        CloseButton.Content = _isThai ? "ปิด" : "CLOSE";
        LoadingTitleText.Text = _isThai ? "กำลังอ่านแพตช์ล่าสุดและข้อมูลไอเทม..." : "READING CURRENT PATCH + BUILD DATA...";
        LoadingDetailText.Text = _isThai ? "แพตช์ Valve • ไอเทม OpenDota • วิเคราะห์ด้วย Gemini" : "Valve patch notes • OpenDota items • Gemini analysis";
        ErrorTitleText.Text = _isThai ? "วิเคราะห์ไม่สำเร็จ" : "ANALYSIS FAILED";
        RetryButton.Content = _isThai ? "ลองอีกครั้ง" : "TRY AGAIN";
        OverviewHeaderText.Text = _isThai ? "ภาพรวม" : "OVERVIEW";
        HowToPlayHeaderText.Text = _isThai ? "แผนการเล่น" : "HOW TO PLAY";
        LanePhaseHeaderText.Text = _isThai ? "ช่วงยืนเลน" : "LANE PHASE";
        TeamFightHeaderText.Text = _isThai ? "ทีมไฟต์" : "TEAM FIGHT";
        PickOffHeaderText.Text = _isThai ? "จับแยก" : "PICK OFF";
        LosingGameHeaderText.Text = _isThai ? "เกมตาม" : "LOSING GAME";
        CountersHeaderText.Text = _isThai ? "ตัวแก้ทาง" : "COUNTERS";
        ReplacementHeaderText.Text = _isThai ? "ตัวเลือกทดแทน" : "REPLACEMENTS";
        CriticalHeaderText.Text = _isThai ? "จุดสำคัญ — ห้ามพลาด" : "CRITICAL — DO NOT MISS";
        OverviewTab.Header = _isThai ? "ภาพรวม" : "OVERVIEW";
        Pos1Tab.Header = BuildHeroTabHeader("carry", "1", 0);
        Pos2Tab.Header = BuildHeroTabHeader("mid", "2", 1);
        Pos5Tab.Header = BuildHeroTabHeader("support", "5", 2);
        DisclaimerText.Text = _isThai
            ? "แนวทางออกไอเทมอ้างอิงแพตช์ Valve ล่าสุดและความนิยมจาก OpenDota — AI อาจผิดพลาดได้"
            : "Builds use current Valve patch + OpenDota popularity. AI can still be wrong.";
        ReanalyzeButton.Content = _isThai ? "อัปเดตแพตช์ + วิเคราะห์ใหม่" : "REFRESH PATCH + ANALYZE";
        ModelText.Text = _isThai
            ? "GEMINI FLASH • JSON คงรูปแบบ • บริบทแพตช์ล่าสุด"
            : "GEMINI FLASH • FIXED SCHEMA • LIVE PATCH CONTEXT";
    }

    private static RoleExecutionPlan? FindRolePlan(ComboAnalysis analysis, string position, int fallbackIndex)
    {
        return analysis.RolePlans.FirstOrDefault(plan => plan.Position.Equals(position, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            ?? analysis.RolePlans.ElementAtOrDefault(fallbackIndex);
    }

    private string BuildHeroTabHeader(string role, string position, int fallbackIndex)
    {
        var pick = _lineup.Picks.FirstOrDefault(value => value.Role.Equals(role, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            ?? _lineup.Picks.ElementAtOrDefault(fallbackIndex);
        if (pick is null)
        {
            return $"POS {position}";
        }

        return _isThai
            ? $"{pick.Name} • {LocalizeRole(pick.Role)}"
            : $"{pick.Name} • POS {position}";
    }

    private void ApplyResultLanguage(ComboAnalysis analysis)
    {
        foreach (var heroBuild in analysis.HeroBuilds)
        {
            heroBuild.RoleDisplay = _isThai
                ? $"ตำแหน่ง: {LocalizeRole(heroBuild.Role)}"
                : $"ROLE: {heroBuild.Role}";
            heroBuild.KeyItemDisplay = _isThai
                ? $"ไอเทมหลัก: {heroBuild.KeyItem}"
                : $"KEY ITEM: {heroBuild.KeyItem}";
            heroBuild.CriticalRuleDisplay = _isThai
                ? $"สำคัญ: {heroBuild.CriticalRule}"
                : $"CRITICAL: {heroBuild.CriticalRule}";
        }

        foreach (var criticalStage in analysis.CriticalStages)
        {
            criticalStage.FailureImpactDisplay = _isThai
                ? $"พลาดแล้ว: {criticalStage.FailureImpact}"
                : $"FAILURE: {criticalStage.FailureImpact}";
        }

        foreach (var rolePlan in analysis.RolePlans)
        {
            ApplyMapGuide(rolePlan);
        }
    }

    private void ApplyMapGuide(RoleExecutionPlan rolePlan)
    {
        var routes = rolePlan.Position switch
        {
            "1" => _isThai
                ? ("1 เวฟเลนปลอดภัย → 2 แคมป์ใหญ่ใกล้เลน → 3 แคมป์ใหญ่ชั้นใน → 4 แคมป์กลาง → 5 Ancient",
                   "ฟาร์มเป็นวงสั้น: เก็บเวฟก่อน แล้วต่อแคมป์ใหญ่/Ancient เฉพาะเมื่อเห็นฮีโร่ศัตรูตัวเปิดไฟต์")
                : ("1 Safe-lane wave → 2 outer hard camp → 3 inner hard camp → 4 medium camp → 5 Ancient",
                   "Farm a short loop: clear the wave first, then hard/Ancient camps only when enemy initiators are visible."),
            "2" => _isThai
                ? ("1 เวฟกลาง → 2 แคมป์ใหญ่ใกล้มิด → 3 Ancient → 4 แคมป์กลาง → 5 แคมป์ใหญ่ฝั่งปลอดภัย",
                   "ดันเวฟกลางให้ชนก่อนหายเข้าป่า เช็ก rune/TP แล้วกลับมารับเวฟถัดไป ไม่เดินลึกโดยไม่มีข้อมูล")
                : ("1 Mid wave → 2 nearby hard camp → 3 Ancient → 4 medium camp → 5 safe-side hard camp",
                   "Push mid before disappearing into the jungle, check rune/TP, then return for the next wave. Do not go deep without vision."),
            "5" => _isThai
                ? ("1 ยืนเลนเซฟ → 2 แคมป์ดึงใกล้เลน → 3 แคมป์ซ้อน/ดึง → 4 จุด ward ปลอดภัย → 5 Stack Ancient",
                   "หน้าที่หลักคือดึงและ stack ไม่แย่งเวฟแคร์รี่ เดินเข้าป่าเมื่อมีเพื่อนใกล้หรือมี ward คุมทางเข้า")
                : ("1 Hold safe lane → 2 pull camp → 3 stack/pull camp → 4 safe ward area → 5 stack Ancient",
                   "Prioritize pulling and stacking without taking the carry's wave. Enter jungle only with an ally nearby or warded entrances."),
            _ => _isThai
                ? ("1 เวฟปลอดภัย → 2 แคมป์ใกล้สุด → 3 แคมป์ชั้นใน → 4 จุดรวมทีม → 5 Ancient",
                   "เลือกเส้นทางสั้นที่มี vision และตัดเส้นทางทันทีเมื่อฮีโร่ศัตรูหายจากแมพ")
                : ("1 Safe wave → 2 nearest camp → 3 inner camp → 4 team area → 5 Ancient",
                   "Use the shortest warded route and abort immediately when enemy heroes disappear from the map.")
        };

        rolePlan.RadiantMapRoute = (_isThai ? "Radiant: " : "RADIANT: ") + routes.Item1;
        rolePlan.DireMapRoute = (_isThai ? "Dire: ใช้เส้นสีส้มแบบกลับด้าน — " : "DIRE: Follow the mirrored orange route — ") + routes.Item1;
        rolePlan.MapFarmRule = routes.Item2;
    }

    private string LocalizeRole(string role)
    {
        if (!_isThai)
        {
            return role;
        }

        return role.ToLowerInvariant() switch
        {
            "carry" => "แคร์รี่",
            "mid" => "มิด",
            "support" => "ซัพพอร์ต",
            _ => role
        };
    }

    private static LineupAnalysisRequest CreateRequest(RowConfig row)
    {
        var picksElement = row.Cells["pick"].GetProperty("picks");
        var picks = picksElement.EnumerateArray()
            .Select(pick => new LineupPick(
                GetString(pick, "hero"),
                GetString(pick, "name"),
                GetString(pick, "role")))
            .ToList();
        var detail = row.Cells["detail"];
        return new LineupAnalysisRequest(
            picks,
            GetString(detail, "specialty"),
            GetString(detail, "winCondition"));
    }

    private static string GetString(JsonElement element, string propertyName)
    {
        return element.TryGetProperty(propertyName, out var property) ? property.GetString() ?? string.Empty : string.Empty;
    }

    private async void RetryButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs eventArgs) => await LoadAnalysisAsync(false);

    private async void ReanalyzeButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs eventArgs) => await LoadAnalysisAsync(true);

    private void CloseButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs eventArgs) => Close();
}
```

```
                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding ItemName}" FontWeight="SemiBold" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Reason}" FontSize="10" Foreground="{StaticResource SecondaryText}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                                        </StackPanel>
                                    </Grid>
                                </Border>
                            </DataTemplate>
                        </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl>
                    <ItemsControl Margin="0,2,0,0" ItemsSource="{Binding FinalItems}">
                        <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel><ItemsPanelTemplate><WrapPanel /></ItemsPanelTemplate></ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                        <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate><DataTemplate><Border Margin="0,0,7,0" ToolTip="{Binding ItemName}"><Image Width="46" Height="34" Source="{Binding IconPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" /></Border></DataTemplate></ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl>
                </StackPanel>
            </Border>
        </DataTemplate>

        <DataTemplate x:Key="RolePlanTemplate">
            <ScrollViewer Padding="16,14,9,18" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                <StackPanel>
                    <Border Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <Grid>
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="64" /><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <Border Width="54" Height="54" CornerRadius="8" ClipToBounds="True"><Image Source="{Binding IconPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" /></Border>
                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Margin="12,0,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Hero}" FontSize="23" FontWeight="Bold" />
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Position, StringFormat='POSITION {0} • HERO EXECUTION PLAN'}" Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBrush}" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold" />
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Grid>
                            <TextBlock Margin="0,13,0,0" Text="LANE POSITION / ตำแหน่งยืนเลน" Foreground="{StaticResource AnalysisWarning}" FontWeight="Bold" />
                            <TextBlock Margin="0,5,0,0" Text="{Binding LanePositioning}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Border>

                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Text="TIMELINE / แผนตามเวลา" />
                    <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Timeline}">
                        <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                            <DataTemplate>
                                <Border Margin="0,0,0,7" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}" Padding="11">
                                    <Grid>
                                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="105" /><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding Minute}" Foreground="{StaticResource AnalysisWarning}" FontWeight="Bold" VerticalAlignment="Top" />
                                        <StackPanel Grid.Column="1">
                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Action}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                                            <TextBlock Margin="0,3,0,0" Text="{Binding Objective, StringFormat='→ {0}'}" Foreground="{StaticResource SecondaryText}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                                        </StackPanel>
                                    </Grid>
                                </Border>
                            </DataTemplate>
                        </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl>

                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Text="LIVE MAP FARM GUIDE / เส้นทางฟาร์มบนแผนที่" />
                    <Border Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}" Padding="12">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <Grid Margin="0,0,0,10">
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" /></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <StackPanel>
                                    <TextBlock Text="CURRENT DOTA 2 MAP + NEUTRAL CAMP SPAWNS" FontWeight="Bold" />
                                    <TextBlock Margin="0,2,0,0" Text="พิกัดจุดเกิดดึงจาก map entities ของเกม • เลข 1–5 คือเส้นทางแนะนำ" Style="{StaticResource MicroLabelStyle}" />
                                </StackPanel>
                                <Border Grid.Column="1" Background="{StaticResource AnalysisCardInset}" CornerRadius="5" Padding="8,4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="RADIANT ━  DIRE ┅" Style="{StaticResource MicroLabelStyle}" />
                                </Border>
                            </Grid>
                            <controls:FarmRouteMap Height="700" RolePlan="{Binding}" />

                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /><ColumnDefinition Width="12" /><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <Border Background="#172729" CornerRadius="7" Padding="10">

                                </Border>

                        <Border Margin="5,0,0,5" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}"><StackPanel><TextBlock Text="SAFE FARM / ฟาร์มปลอดภัย" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock Margin="0,4,0,0" Text="{Binding SafeFarm}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel></Border>

                            <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Build.Options}" ItemTemplate="{StaticResource BuildOptionTemplate}" />
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Border>
                </StackPanel>

        </DataTemplate>

    <Grid Margin="18">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions><RowDefinition Height="Auto" /><RowDefinition Height="12" /><RowDefinition Height="*" /><RowDefinition Height="Auto" /></Grid.RowDefinitions>

                            <Border Margin="0,0,8,6" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}" Padding="7,5">
                                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal"><Image Width="30" Height="30" Source="{Binding IconPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" /><StackPanel Margin="8,0,0,0"><TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontWeight="SemiBold" /><TextBlock Text="{Binding RoleDisplay}" Style="{StaticResource MicroLabelStyle}" /></StackPanel></StackPanel>

                        </DataTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>

        </Grid>

        <Border Grid.Row="2" Background="{StaticResource PanelBackground}" BorderBrush="{StaticResource BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="10" ClipToBounds="True">
            <Grid>
                <StackPanel x:Name="LoadingPanel" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <TextBlock x:Name="LoadingTitleText" Text="READING CURRENT PATCH + BUILD DATA..." HorizontalAlignment="Center" Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBrush}" FontSize="17" />
                    <ProgressBar Width="280" Height="4" Margin="0,14,0,0" IsIndeterminate="True" />
                    <TextBlock x:Name="LoadingDetailText" Margin="0,10,0,0" Text="Valve patch notes • OpenDota items • Gemini analysis" Foreground="{StaticResource SecondaryText}" />

                <StackPanel x:Name="ErrorPanel" Margin="32" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" Visibility="Collapsed">
                    <TextBlock x:Name="ErrorTitleText" Text="ANALYSIS FAILED" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBrush}" FontSize="20" />
                    <TextBlock x:Name="ErrorText" Margin="0,12,0,16" MaxWidth="620" TextAlignment="Center" TextWrapping="Wrap" />

                <TabControl x:Name="AnalysisTabs" Visibility="Collapsed">

                                    <Border Margin="5,0,0,5" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}"><StackPanel><TextBlock x:Name="TeamFightHeaderText" Text="TEAM FIGHT" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock x:Name="TeamFightText" Margin="0,5,0,0" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel></Border>
                                    <Border Margin="0,5,5,0" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}"><StackPanel><TextBlock x:Name="PickOffHeaderText" Text="PICK OFF" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock x:Name="PickOffText" Margin="0,5,0,0" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel></Border>
                                    <Border Margin="5,5,0,0" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}"><StackPanel><TextBlock x:Name="LosingGameHeaderText" Text="LOSING GAME" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock x:Name="LosingGameText" Margin="0,5,0,0" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel></Border>
                                </UniformGrid>

                                <TextBlock x:Name="CountersHeaderText" Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Text="COUNTERS" />
                                <ItemsControl x:Name="CounterItems">
                                    <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <Border Margin="0,0,0,7" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}" Padding="10">
                                                <Grid><Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="46" /><ColumnDefinition Width="150" /><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /></Grid.ColumnDefinitions><Image Width="38" Height="38" Source="{Binding IconPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" /><TextBlock Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding Hero}" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontWeight="Bold" /><StackPanel Grid.Column="2" VerticalAlignment="Center"><TextBlock Text="{Binding Threat}" FontSize="12" TextWrapping="Wrap" /><TextBlock Margin="0,2,0,0" Text="{Binding Response, StringFormat='→ {0}'}" FontSize="11" Foreground="{StaticResource SecondaryText}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel></Grid>
                                            </Border>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl>

                                <TextBlock x:Name="ReplacementHeaderText" Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Text="REPLACEMENTS" />
                                <ItemsControl x:Name="ReplacementItems">
                                    <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <Border Margin="0,0,0,8" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}">
                                                <StackPanel>
                                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal"><Image Width="36" Height="36" Source="{Binding OriginalHeroIconPath}" /><TextBlock Margin="9,0,0,0" Text="{Binding OriginalHero}" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontWeight="Bold" /></StackPanel>
                                                    <ItemsControl Margin="0,8,0,0" ItemsSource="{Binding Alternatives}">
                                                        <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                                            <DataTemplate>
                                                                <Border Margin="0,0,0,5" Background="{StaticResource AnalysisCardRaised}" CornerRadius="6" Padding="8">
                                                                    <Grid><Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="42" /><ColumnDefinition Width="145" /><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /></Grid.ColumnDefinitions><Image Width="34" Height="34" Source="{Binding IconPath}" /><TextBlock Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding Hero}" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontWeight="SemiBold" /><TextBlock Grid.Column="2" Text="{Binding Reason}" VerticalAlignment="Center" Foreground="{StaticResource SecondaryText}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></Grid>
                                                                </Border>
                                                            </DataTemplate>
                                                        </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                                    </ItemsControl>
                                                </StackPanel>
                                            </Border>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl>

                                <TextBlock x:Name="CriticalHeaderText" Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Foreground="{StaticResource AnalysisWarning}" Text="CRITICAL — DO NOT MISS" />
                                <ItemsControl x:Name="CriticalItems">
                                    <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <Border Margin="0,0,0,7" Background="#281A1A" BorderBrush="#58302C" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="9" Padding="11">
                                                <StackPanel><TextBlock Text="{Binding Owner}" Foreground="{StaticResource AnalysisWarning}" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock Margin="0,3,0,0" Text="{Binding Rule}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /><TextBlock Margin="0,3,0,0" Text="{Binding FailureImpactDisplay}" Foreground="{StaticResource SecondaryText}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel>
                                            </Border>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </ScrollViewer>
                    </TabItem>
                    <TabItem x:Name="Pos1Tab" Header="POS 1 — CARRY"><ContentControl x:Name="Pos1Content" ContentTemplate="{StaticResource RolePlanTemplate}" /></TabItem>
                    <TabItem x:Name="Pos2Tab" Header="POS 2 — MID"><ContentControl x:Name="Pos2Content" ContentTemplate="{StaticResource RolePlanTemplate}" /></TabItem>
                    <TabItem x:Name="Pos5Tab" Header="POS 5 — SUPPORT"><ContentControl x:Name="Pos5Content" ContentTemplate="{StaticResource RolePlanTemplate}" /></TabItem>
                </TabControl>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <Grid Grid.Row="3" Margin="2,10,2,0">
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" /></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
            <TextBlock x:Name="DisclaimerText" VerticalAlignment="Center" Foreground="{StaticResource SecondaryText}" FontSize="11" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
            <Button x:Name="ReanalyzeButton" Grid.Column="1" Content="REFRESH PATCH + ANALYZE" Visibility="Collapsed" Click="ReanalyzeButton_Click" />
        </Grid>
    </Grid>
</Window>
```

```
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Imaging;
using DotaComboBoard.Models;
using Brush = System.Windows.Media.Brush;
using Brushes = System.Windows.Media.Brushes;
using Color = System.Windows.Media.Color;
using Point = System.Windows.Point;

namespace DotaComboBoard.Controls;

public sealed class FarmRouteMap : FrameworkElement
{
    private const double WorldMin = -9000;
    private const double WorldRange = 18000;
    private ImageSource? _mapImage;
    private string _loadedMapPath = string.Empty;

    public static readonly DependencyProperty RolePlanProperty = DependencyProperty.Register(
        nameof(RolePlan),
        typeof(RoleExecutionPlan),
        typeof(FarmRouteMap),
        new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    public RoleExecutionPlan? RolePlan
    {
        get => (RoleExecutionPlan?)GetValue(RolePlanProperty);
        set => SetValue(RolePlanProperty, value);
    }

    protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
    {
        base.OnRender(drawingContext);

        var side = Math.Min(ActualWidth, ActualHeight);
        var mapRect = new Rect((ActualWidth - side) / 2, 0, side, side);
        drawingContext.DrawRoundedRectangle(new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(10, 14, 18)), null, mapRect, 12, 12);

        var image = LoadMapImage();
        if (image is not null)
        {
            drawingContext.PushClip(new RectangleGeometry(mapRect, 12, 12));
            drawingContext.DrawImage(image, mapRect);
            drawingContext.DrawRectangle(new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromArgb(72, 5, 8, 12)), null, mapRect);
            drawingContext.Pop();
        }

        DrawSafeZones(drawingContext, mapRect);
        DrawAllCamps(drawingContext, mapRect);
        DrawRoute(drawingContext, mapRect, GetRoute(isRadiant: true), Color.FromRgb(78, 205, 196), false);
        DrawRoute(drawingContext, mapRect, GetRoute(isRadiant: false), Color.FromRgb(244, 166, 76), true);
        DrawMapLabels(drawingContext, mapRect);
        drawingContext.DrawRoundedRectangle(null, new Pen(new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(58, 69, 82)), 1), mapRect, 12, 12);
    }

    private ImageSource? LoadMapImage()
    {
        var path = RolePlan?.MapImagePath;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path) || !File.Exists(path))
        {
            return null;
        }

        if (_mapImage is not null && path.Equals(_loadedMapPath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            return _mapImage;
        }

        var bitmap = new BitmapImage();
        bitmap.BeginInit();
        bitmap.CacheOption = BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad;
        bitmap.UriSource = new Uri(path, UriKind.Absolute);
        bitmap.EndInit();
        bitmap.Freeze();
        _loadedMapPath = path;
        _mapImage = bitmap;
        return _mapImage;
    }

    private static void DrawSafeZones(DrawingContext context, Rect rect)
    {
        var radiantZone = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromArgb(44, 78, 205, 196));
        var direZone = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromArgb(42, 244, 166, 76));
        context.DrawEllipse(radiantZone, null, ToPoint(rect, -1800, -4300), rect.Width * .26, rect.Height * .22);
        context.DrawEllipse(direZone, null, ToPoint(rect, -1100, 4600), rect.Width * .26, rect.Height * .22);
    }

    private static void DrawAllCamps(DrawingContext context, Rect rect)
    {
        foreach (var camp in Camps)
        {
            var center = ToPoint(rect, camp.X, camp.Y);
            var fill = camp.Kind switch
            {
                CampKind.Ancient => Color.FromRgb(194, 123, 255),
                CampKind.Hard => Color.FromRgb(236, 95, 86),
                _ => Color.FromRgb(228, 233, 239)
            };
            var radius = camp.Kind == CampKind.Ancient ? 5.8 : 4.6;
            context.DrawEllipse(new SolidColorBrush(fill), new Pen(Brushes.Black, 1.2), center, radius, radius);
        }
    }

    private static void DrawRoute(
        DrawingContext context,
        Rect rect,
        IReadOnlyList<MapNode> route,
        Color routeColor,
        bool dashed)
    {
        if (route.Count == 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        var brush = new SolidColorBrush(routeColor);
        var pen = new Pen(brush, 3.2)
        {
            DashStyle = dashed ? DashStyles.Dash : DashStyles.Solid,
            LineJoin = PenLineJoin.Round,
            StartLineCap = PenLineCap.Round,
            EndLineCap = PenLineCap.Round
        };

        for (var index = 1; index < route.Count; index++)
        {
            context.DrawLine(pen, ToPoint(rect, route[index - 1].X, route[index - 1].Y), ToPoint(rect, route[index].X, route[index].Y));
        }

        for (var index = 0; index < route.Count; index++)
        {
            var center = ToPoint(rect, route[index].X, route[index].Y);
            context.DrawEllipse(new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(14, 18, 23)), new Pen(brush, 2.6), center, 11, 11);
            DrawText(context, (index + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), center.X - 3.5, center.Y - 8, 12, Brushes.White, FontWeights.Bold);
        }
    }

    private static void DrawMapLabels(DrawingContext context, Rect rect)
    {
        DrawLabel(context, rect.Left + 14, rect.Bottom - 38, "RADIANT", Color.FromRgb(78, 205, 196));
        DrawLabel(context, rect.Right - 72, rect.Top + 14, "DIRE", Color.FromRgb(244, 166, 76));
        DrawLabel(context, rect.Left + 14, rect.Top + 14, "N  CAMP   H  HARD   A  ANCIENT", Color.FromRgb(226, 231, 237), 10);
    }

    private static void DrawLabel(DrawingContext context, double x, double y, string text, Color color, double size = 11)
    {
        var formatted = CreateText(text, size, new SolidColorBrush(color), FontWeights.Bold);
        var background = new Rect(x - 6, y - 3, formatted.Width + 12, formatted.Height + 6);
        context.DrawRoundedRectangle(new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromArgb(210, 12, 16, 21)), null, background, 4, 4);
        context.DrawText(formatted, new Point(x, y));
    }

    private static void DrawText(DrawingContext context, string text, double x, double y, double size, Brush brush, FontWeight weight)
    {
        context.DrawText(CreateText(text, size, brush, weight), new Point(x, y));
    }

    private static FormattedText CreateText(string text, double size, Brush brush, FontWeight weight)
    {
        return new FormattedText(
            text,
            CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
            FlowDirection.LeftToRight,
            new Typeface(new FontFamily("Segoe UI"), FontStyles.Normal, weight, FontStretches.Normal),
            size,
            brush,
            1.0);
    }

    private IReadOnlyList<MapNode> GetRoute(bool isRadiant)
    {
        var position = RolePlan?.Position?.Trim();
        return (position, isRadiant) switch
        {
            ("1", true) => [new(5900, -6400), Camp("good_1"), Camp("good_2"), Camp("good_15"), Camp("good_14")],
            ("1", false) => [new(-5700, 6500), Camp("evil_1"), Camp("evil_2"), Camp("evil_15"), Camp("evil_14")],
            ("2", true) => [new(-500, -650), Camp("good_5"), Camp("good_4"), Camp("good_15"), Camp("good_1")],
            ("2", false) => [new(500, 650), Camp("evil_5"), Camp("evil_6"), Camp("evil_15"), Camp("evil_1")],
            ("5", true) => [new(5700, -6500), Camp("good_2"), Camp("good_1"), Camp("good_15"), Camp("good_4")],
            ("5", false) => [new(-5600, 6500), Camp("evil_2"), Camp("evil_1"), Camp("evil_15"), Camp("evil_6")],
            (_, true) => [new(-500, -650), Camp("good_5"), Camp("good_4")],
            _ => [new(500, 650), Camp("evil_5"), Camp("evil_6")]
        };
    }

    private static MapNode Camp(string id)
    {
        var camp = Camps.First(value => value.Id.Equals(id, StringComparison.Ordinal));
        return new MapNode(camp.X, camp.Y);
    }

    private static Point ToPoint(Rect rect, double x, double y)
    {
        return new Point(
            rect.Left + ((x - WorldMin) / WorldRange * rect.Width),
            rect.Top + ((WorldMin + WorldRange - y) / WorldRange * rect.Height));
    }

    private static readonly IReadOnlyList<CampPoint> Camps =
    [
        new("evil_1", -4823.878906, 3914.796143, CampKind.Hard),
        new("evil_11", -2880, 7376, CampKind.Ancient),

        new("good_2", 4649.26123, -3698.830566, CampKind.Hard),
```

```
using Pen = System.Windows.Media.Pen;
using Point = System.Windows.Point;

namespace DotaComboBoard.Controls;

{
    private const double WorldMin = -9000;
    private const double WorldRange = 18000;
    private ImageSource? _mapImage;
    private string _loadedMapPath = string.Empty;

    public static readonly DependencyProperty RolePlanProperty = DependencyProperty.Register(
        nameof(RolePlan),
        typeof(RoleExecutionPlan),
        typeof(FarmRouteMap),
        new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    public RoleExecutionPlan? RolePlan
    {
        get => (RoleExecutionPlan?)GetValue(RolePlanProperty);
        set => SetValue(RolePlanProperty, value);
    }

    protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext drawingContext)
    {
        base.OnRender(drawingContext);

        var side = Math.Min(ActualWidth, ActualHeight);
        var mapRect = new Rect((ActualWidth - side) / 2, 0, side, side);
        drawingContext.DrawRoundedRectangle(new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(10, 14, 18)), null, mapRect, 12, 12);

        var image = LoadMapImage();
        if (image is not null)
        {
            drawingContext.PushClip(new RectangleGeometry(mapRect, 12, 12));
            drawingContext.DrawImage(image, mapRect);
            drawingContext.DrawRectangle(new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromArgb(72, 5, 8, 12)), null, mapRect);
            drawingContext.Pop();
        }

        DrawSafeZones(drawingContext, mapRect);
        DrawAllCamps(drawingContext, mapRect);
        DrawRoute(drawingContext, mapRect, GetRoute(isRadiant: true), Color.FromRgb(78, 205, 196), false);
        DrawRoute(drawingContext, mapRect, GetRoute(isRadiant: false), Color.FromRgb(244, 166, 76), true);
        DrawMapLabels(drawingContext, mapRect);
        drawingContext.DrawRoundedRectangle(null, new Pen(new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(58, 69, 82)), 1), mapRect, 12, 12);
    }

    private ImageSource? LoadMapImage()
    {
        var path = RolePlan?.MapImagePath;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path) || !File.Exists(path))
        {
            return null;
        }

        if (_mapImage is not null && path.Equals(_loadedMapPath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            return _mapImage;
        }

        var bitmap = new BitmapImage();
        bitmap.BeginInit();
        bitmap.CacheOption = BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad;
        bitmap.UriSource = new Uri(path, UriKind.Absolute);
        bitmap.EndInit();
        bitmap.Freeze();
        _loadedMapPath = path;
        _mapImage = bitmap;
        return _mapImage;
    }

    private static void DrawSafeZones(DrawingContext context, Rect rect)
    {
        var radiantZone = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromArgb(44, 78, 205, 196));
        var direZone = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromArgb(42, 244, 166, 76));
        context.DrawEllipse(radiantZone, null, ToPoint(rect, -1800, -4300), rect.Width * .26, rect.Height * .22);
        context.DrawEllipse(direZone, null, ToPoint(rect, -1100, 4600), rect.Width * .26, rect.Height * .22);
    }

    private static void DrawAllCamps(DrawingContext context, Rect rect)
    {
        foreach (var camp in Camps)
        {
            var center = ToPoint(rect, camp.X, camp.Y);
            var fill = camp.Kind switch
            {
                CampKind.Ancient => Color.FromRgb(194, 123, 255),
                CampKind.Hard => Color.FromRgb(236, 95, 86),
                _ => Color.FromRgb(228, 233, 239)
            };
            var radius = camp.Kind == CampKind.Ancient ? 5.8 : 4.6;
            context.DrawEllipse(new SolidColorBrush(fill), new Pen(Brushes.Black, 1.2), center, radius, radius);
        }
    }

    private static void DrawRoute(
        DrawingContext context,
        Rect rect,
        IReadOnlyList<MapNode> route,
        Color routeColor,
        bool dashed)
    {
        if (route.Count == 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        var brush = new SolidColorBrush(routeColor);
        var pen = new Pen(brush, 3.2)
        {
            DashStyle = dashed ? DashStyles.Dash : DashStyles.Solid,
            LineJoin = PenLineJoin.Round,
            StartLineCap = PenLineCap.Round,
            EndLineCap = PenLineCap.Round
        };

        for (var index = 1; index < route.Count; index++)
        {
            context.DrawLine(pen, ToPoint(rect, route[index - 1].X, route[index - 1].Y), ToPoint(rect, route[index].X, route[index].Y));
        }

        for (var index = 0; index < route.Count; index++)
        {
            var center = ToPoint(rect, route[index].X, route[index].Y);
            context.DrawEllipse(new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(14, 18, 23)), new Pen(brush, 2.6), center, 11, 11);
            DrawText(context, (index + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), center.X - 3.5, center.Y - 8, 12, Brushes.White, FontWeights.Bold);
        }
    }

    private static void DrawMapLabels(DrawingContext context, Rect rect)
    {
        DrawLabel(context, rect.Left + 14, rect.Bottom - 38, "RADIANT", Color.FromRgb(78, 205, 196));
        DrawLabel(context, rect.Right - 72, rect.Top + 14, "DIRE", Color.FromRgb(244, 166, 76));
        DrawLabel(context, rect.Left + 14, rect.Top + 14, "N  CAMP   H  HARD   A  ANCIENT", Color.FromRgb(226, 231, 237), 10);
    }

    {

        var background = new Rect(x - 6, y - 3, formatted.Width + 12, formatted.Height + 6);
        context.DrawRoundedRectangle(new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromArgb(210, 12, 16, 21)), null, background, 4, 4);
        context.DrawText(formatted, new Point(x, y));
    }

    private static void DrawText(DrawingContext context, string text, double x, double y, double size, Brush brush, FontWeight weight)
    {
        context.DrawText(CreateText(text, size, brush, weight), new Point(x, y));
    }

    private static FormattedText CreateText(string text, double size, Brush brush, FontWeight weight)
    {
        return new FormattedText(

            System.Windows.FlowDirection.LeftToRight,
            new Typeface(new FontFamily("Segoe UI"), FontStyles.Normal, weight, FontStretches.Normal),
            size,
            brush,
            1.0);
    }

    {

            (_, true) => [new(-500, -650), Camp("good_5"), Camp("good_4")],
            _ => [new(500, 650), Camp("evil_5"), Camp("evil_6")]
        };
    }

    private static MapNode Camp(string id)
    {

    {
```

```
<Window x:Class="DotaComboBoard.AnalysisWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:controls="clr-namespace:DotaComboBoard.Controls"
        Title="Lineup Analysis" Width="1040" Height="1180" MinWidth="760" MinHeight="720" MaxHeight="1400"
        Background="{StaticResource AppBackground}" Foreground="{StaticResource PrimaryText}"
        FontFamily="{DynamicResource AppFont}" FontSize="14" WindowStartupLocation="CenterOwner" ShowInTaskbar="False">
    <Window.Resources>
        <SolidColorBrush x:Key="AnalysisCard" Color="#161C23" />
        <SolidColorBrush x:Key="AnalysisCardRaised" Color="#1B232C" />
        <SolidColorBrush x:Key="AnalysisCardInset" Color="#11161C" />
        <SolidColorBrush x:Key="AnalysisSuccess" Color="#5FD09A" />
        <SolidColorBrush x:Key="AnalysisWarning" Color="#F4C46A" />
        <SolidColorBrush x:Key="AnalysisDanger" Color="#EF6A5B" />
        <SolidColorBrush x:Key="RadiantRoute" Color="#4ECDC4" />
        <SolidColorBrush x:Key="DireRoute" Color="#F4A64C" />

        <Style x:Key="AnalysisCardStyle" TargetType="Border">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource AnalysisCard}" />
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource BorderBrush}" />
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1" />
            <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="9" />
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="13" />
        </Style>
        <Style x:Key="SectionTitleStyle" TargetType="TextBlock">
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="2,20,0,8" />
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource AccentBrush}" />
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="18" />
            <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="Bold" />
        </Style>
        <Style x:Key="MicroLabelStyle" TargetType="TextBlock">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource SecondaryText}" />
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="11" />
            <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="SemiBold" />
        </Style>
        <Style TargetType="TabControl">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent" />
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0" />
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="0" />
        </Style>
        <Style TargetType="TabItem">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource SecondaryText}" />
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent" />
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0" />
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="14,10" />
            <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="SemiBold" />
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand" />
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="TabItem">
                        <Border x:Name="TabSurface" Margin="3,4,3,6" Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}"
                                Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" CornerRadius="7">
                            <ContentPresenter ContentSource="Header" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="TabSurface" Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource AnalysisCardRaised}" />
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource PrimaryText}" />
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="TabSurface" Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource AccentBrush}" />
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="White" />
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <DataTemplate x:Key="BuildOptionTemplate">
            <Border Margin="0,7,0,0" Background="{StaticResource AnalysisCardRaised}"
                    BorderBrush="{StaticResource BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="7" Padding="11">
                <StackPanel>
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontWeight="Bold" />
                    <TextBlock Margin="0,3,0,8" Text="{Binding Goal}" Foreground="{StaticResource SecondaryText}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                    <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Timings}">
                        <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel><ItemsPanelTemplate><WrapPanel /></ItemsPanelTemplate></ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                        <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                            <DataTemplate>
                                <Border Width="250" MinHeight="66" Margin="0,0,7,7" Background="{StaticResource AnalysisCardInset}" CornerRadius="6" Padding="8">
                                    <Grid>
                                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="40" /><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <Image Width="36" Height="27" Source="{Binding IconPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" />
                                        <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Margin="8,0,0,0">
                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Timing}" Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBrush}" FontSize="10" />
                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding ItemName}" FontWeight="SemiBold" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Reason}" FontSize="10" Foreground="{StaticResource SecondaryText}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                                        </StackPanel>
                                    </Grid>
                                </Border>
                            </DataTemplate>
                        </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl>
                    <ItemsControl Margin="0,2,0,0" ItemsSource="{Binding FinalItems}">
                        <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel><ItemsPanelTemplate><WrapPanel /></ItemsPanelTemplate></ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                        <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate><DataTemplate><Border Margin="0,0,7,0" ToolTip="{Binding ItemName}"><Image Width="46" Height="34" Source="{Binding IconPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" /></Border></DataTemplate></ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl>
                </StackPanel>
            </Border>
        </DataTemplate>

        <DataTemplate x:Key="RolePlanTemplate">
            <ScrollViewer Padding="16,14,9,18" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                <StackPanel>
                    <Border Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <Grid>
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="64" /><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <Border Width="54" Height="54" CornerRadius="8" ClipToBounds="True"><Image Source="{Binding IconPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" /></Border>
                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Margin="12,0,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Hero}" FontSize="23" FontWeight="Bold" />
                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Position, StringFormat='POSITION {0} • HERO EXECUTION PLAN'}" Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBrush}" FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold" />
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Grid>
                            <TextBlock Margin="0,13,0,0" Text="LANE POSITION / ตำแหน่งยืนเลน" Foreground="{StaticResource AnalysisWarning}" FontWeight="Bold" />
                            <TextBlock Margin="0,5,0,0" Text="{Binding LanePositioning}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Border>

                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Text="TIMELINE / แผนตามเวลา" />
                    <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Timeline}">
                        <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                            <DataTemplate>
                                <Border Margin="0,0,0,7" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}" Padding="11">
                                    <Grid>
                                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="105" /><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding Minute}" Foreground="{StaticResource AnalysisWarning}" FontWeight="Bold" VerticalAlignment="Top" />
                                        <StackPanel Grid.Column="1">
                                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Action}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                                            <TextBlock Margin="0,3,0,0" Text="{Binding Objective, StringFormat='→ {0}'}" Foreground="{StaticResource SecondaryText}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                                        </StackPanel>
                                    </Grid>
                                </Border>
                            </DataTemplate>
                        </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl>

                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Text="LIVE MAP FARM GUIDE / เส้นทางฟาร์มบนแผนที่" />
                    <Border Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}" Padding="12">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <Grid Margin="0,0,0,10">
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" /></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <StackPanel>
                                    <TextBlock Text="CURRENT DOTA 2 MAP + NEUTRAL CAMP SPAWNS" FontWeight="Bold" />
                                    <TextBlock Margin="0,2,0,0" Text="พิกัดจุดเกิดดึงจาก map entities ของเกม • เลข 1–5 คือเส้นทางแนะนำ" Style="{StaticResource MicroLabelStyle}" />
                                </StackPanel>
                                <Border Grid.Column="1" Background="{StaticResource AnalysisCardInset}" CornerRadius="5" Padding="8,4">
                                    <TextBlock Text="RADIANT ━  DIRE ┅" Style="{StaticResource MicroLabelStyle}" />
                                </Border>
                            </Grid>
                            <controls:FarmRouteMap Height="700"
                                                   AutomationProperties.Name="Dota 2 neutral camp farm route map"
                                                   RolePlan="{Binding}" />
                            <Grid Margin="0,12,0,0">
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /><ColumnDefinition Width="12" /><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <Border Background="#172729" CornerRadius="7" Padding="10">
                                    <StackPanel><TextBlock Text="RADIANT ROUTE" Foreground="{StaticResource RadiantRoute}" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock Margin="0,4,0,0" Text="{Binding RadiantMapRoute}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel>
                                </Border>
                                <Border Grid.Column="2" Background="#282116" CornerRadius="7" Padding="10">
                                    <StackPanel><TextBlock Text="DIRE ROUTE" Foreground="{StaticResource DireRoute}" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock Margin="0,4,0,0" Text="{Binding DireMapRoute}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel>
                                </Border>
                            </Grid>
                            <Border Margin="0,10,0,0" Background="{StaticResource AnalysisCardInset}" CornerRadius="7" Padding="10">
                                <StackPanel><TextBlock Text="SAFE FARM RULE / กฎฟาร์มปลอดภัย" Foreground="{StaticResource AnalysisWarning}" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock Margin="0,4,0,0" Text="{Binding MapFarmRule}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel>
                            </Border>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Border>

                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Text="MAP DECISIONS / การตัดสินใจบนแมพ" />
                    <UniformGrid Columns="2">
                        <Border Margin="0,0,5,5" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}"><StackPanel><TextBlock Text="MAP MOVEMENT / เดินแมพ" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock Margin="0,4,0,0" Text="{Binding MapMovement}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel></Border>
                        <Border Margin="5,0,0,5" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}"><StackPanel><TextBlock Text="SAFE FARM / ฟาร์มปลอดภัย" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock Margin="0,4,0,0" Text="{Binding SafeFarm}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel></Border>
                        <Border Margin="0,5,5,5" Background="#17261F" BorderBrush="#28523C" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="9" Padding="13"><StackPanel><TextBlock Text="AHEAD / เกมนำ" Foreground="{StaticResource AnalysisSuccess}" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock Margin="0,4,0,0" Text="{Binding AheadPlan}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel></Border>
                        <Border Margin="5,5,0,5" Background="#281A1A" BorderBrush="#58302C" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="9" Padding="13"><StackPanel><TextBlock Text="BEHIND / เกมตาม" Foreground="{StaticResource AnalysisDanger}" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock Margin="0,4,0,0" Text="{Binding BehindPlan}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel></Border>
                        <Border Margin="0,5,5,0" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}"><StackPanel><TextBlock Text="TRIANGLE TIMING / เข้าสามเหลี่ยม" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock Margin="0,4,0,0" Text="{Binding TriangleTiming}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel></Border>
                        <Border Margin="5,5,0,0" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}"><StackPanel><TextBlock Text="LEVEL TIMING / เร่งเลเวล" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock Margin="0,4,0,0" Text="{Binding LevelTiming}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel></Border>
                    </UniformGrid>

                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Text="CREEP + CAMP ROUTE / เล่นครีปและแคมป์ไหน" />
                    <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding FarmRoute}">
                        <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate><DataTemplate><Border Margin="0,0,0,7" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}" Padding="11"><TextBlock Text="{Binding}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></Border></DataTemplate></ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl>

                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Foreground="{StaticResource AnalysisWarning}" Text="GO / ABORT CHECK / เช็กก่อนขยับ" />
                    <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding DecisionChecks}">
                        <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                            <DataTemplate>
                                <Border Margin="0,0,0,7" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}" Padding="11">
                                    <Grid><Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="26" /><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /></Grid.ColumnDefinitions><TextBlock Text="✓" Foreground="{StaticResource AnalysisWarning}" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></Grid>
                                </Border>
                            </DataTemplate>
                        </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl>

                    <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Text="ITEM BUILDS / แนวทางออกไอเทม" />
                    <Border Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Build.KeyItemDisplay}" Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBrush}" FontWeight="SemiBold" />
                            <TextBlock Margin="0,5,0,4" Text="{Binding Build.CriticalRuleDisplay}" Foreground="{StaticResource AnalysisWarning}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                            <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Build.Options}" ItemTemplate="{StaticResource BuildOptionTemplate}" />
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Border>
                </StackPanel>
            </ScrollViewer>
        </DataTemplate>
    </Window.Resources>

    <Grid Margin="18">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions><RowDefinition Height="Auto" /><RowDefinition Height="12" /><RowDefinition Height="*" /><RowDefinition Height="Auto" /></Grid.RowDefinitions>
        <Grid>
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" /></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
            <StackPanel>
                <TextBlock x:Name="HeaderTitleText" Text="LINEUP INTELLIGENCE" FontSize="24" FontWeight="Bold" />
                <ItemsControl x:Name="LineupItems" Margin="0,9,0,0">
                    <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel><ItemsPanelTemplate><WrapPanel /></ItemsPanelTemplate></ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                    <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                        <DataTemplate>
                            <Border Margin="0,0,8,6" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}" Padding="7,5">
                                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal"><Image Width="30" Height="30" Source="{Binding IconPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" /><StackPanel Margin="8,0,0,0"><TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontWeight="SemiBold" /><TextBlock Text="{Binding RoleDisplay}" Style="{StaticResource MicroLabelStyle}" /></StackPanel></StackPanel>
                            </Border>
                        </DataTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                </ItemsControl>
                <TextBlock x:Name="ModelText" Margin="0,1,0,0" Style="{StaticResource MicroLabelStyle}" />
            </StackPanel>
            <Button x:Name="CloseButton" Grid.Column="1" Content="CLOSE" VerticalAlignment="Top" Click="CloseButton_Click" />
        </Grid>

        <Border Grid.Row="2" Background="{StaticResource PanelBackground}" BorderBrush="{StaticResource BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="10" ClipToBounds="True">
            <Grid>
                <StackPanel x:Name="LoadingPanel" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <TextBlock x:Name="LoadingTitleText" Text="READING CURRENT PATCH + BUILD DATA..." HorizontalAlignment="Center" Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBrush}" FontSize="17" />
                    <ProgressBar Width="280" Height="4" Margin="0,14,0,0" IsIndeterminate="True" />
                    <TextBlock x:Name="LoadingDetailText" Margin="0,10,0,0" Text="Valve patch notes • OpenDota items • Gemini analysis" Foreground="{StaticResource SecondaryText}" />
                </StackPanel>
                <StackPanel x:Name="ErrorPanel" Margin="32" HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" Visibility="Collapsed">
                    <TextBlock x:Name="ErrorTitleText" Text="ANALYSIS FAILED" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBrush}" FontSize="20" />
                    <TextBlock x:Name="ErrorText" Margin="0,12,0,16" MaxWidth="620" TextAlignment="Center" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                    <Button x:Name="RetryButton" Content="TRY AGAIN" HorizontalAlignment="Center" Click="RetryButton_Click" />
                </StackPanel>

                <TabControl x:Name="AnalysisTabs" Visibility="Collapsed">
                    <TabItem x:Name="OverviewTab" Header="OVERVIEW">
                        <ScrollViewer Padding="16,14,9,18" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                            <StackPanel>
                                <Border Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}">
                                    <StackPanel>
                                        <Grid><Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" /></Grid.ColumnDefinitions><TextBlock x:Name="OverviewHeaderText" Text="OVERVIEW" Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBrush}" FontWeight="Bold" /><Border Grid.Column="1" Background="{StaticResource AnalysisCardRaised}" CornerRadius="5" Padding="9,3"><TextBlock x:Name="PatchText" FontSize="11" /></Border></Grid>
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="OverviewText" Margin="0,9,0,0" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </Border>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="HowToPlayHeaderText" Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Text="HOW TO PLAY" />
                                <UniformGrid Columns="2">
                                    <Border Margin="0,0,5,5" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}"><StackPanel><TextBlock x:Name="LanePhaseHeaderText" Text="LANE PHASE" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock x:Name="LanePhaseText" Margin="0,5,0,0" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel></Border>
                                    <Border Margin="5,0,0,5" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}"><StackPanel><TextBlock x:Name="TeamFightHeaderText" Text="TEAM FIGHT" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock x:Name="TeamFightText" Margin="0,5,0,0" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel></Border>
                                    <Border Margin="0,5,5,0" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}"><StackPanel><TextBlock x:Name="PickOffHeaderText" Text="PICK OFF" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock x:Name="PickOffText" Margin="0,5,0,0" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel></Border>
                                    <Border Margin="5,5,0,0" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}"><StackPanel><TextBlock x:Name="LosingGameHeaderText" Text="LOSING GAME" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock x:Name="LosingGameText" Margin="0,5,0,0" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel></Border>
                                </UniformGrid>

                                <TextBlock x:Name="CountersHeaderText" Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Text="COUNTERS" />
                                <ItemsControl x:Name="CounterItems">
                                    <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <Border Margin="0,0,0,7" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}" Padding="10">
                                                <Grid><Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="46" /><ColumnDefinition Width="150" /><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /></Grid.ColumnDefinitions><Image Width="38" Height="38" Source="{Binding IconPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" /><TextBlock Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding Hero}" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontWeight="Bold" /><StackPanel Grid.Column="2" VerticalAlignment="Center"><TextBlock Text="{Binding Threat}" FontSize="12" TextWrapping="Wrap" /><TextBlock Margin="0,2,0,0" Text="{Binding Response, StringFormat='→ {0}'}" FontSize="11" Foreground="{StaticResource SecondaryText}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel></Grid>
                                            </Border>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl>

                                <TextBlock x:Name="ReplacementHeaderText" Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Text="REPLACEMENTS" />
                                <ItemsControl x:Name="ReplacementItems">
                                    <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <Border Margin="0,0,0,8" Style="{StaticResource AnalysisCardStyle}">
                                                <StackPanel>
                                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal"><Image Width="36" Height="36" Source="{Binding OriginalHeroIconPath}" /><TextBlock Margin="9,0,0,0" Text="{Binding OriginalHero}" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontWeight="Bold" /></StackPanel>
                                                    <ItemsControl Margin="0,8,0,0" ItemsSource="{Binding Alternatives}">
                                                        <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                                            <DataTemplate>
                                                                <Border Margin="0,0,0,5" Background="{StaticResource AnalysisCardRaised}" CornerRadius="6" Padding="8">
                                                                    <Grid><Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="42" /><ColumnDefinition Width="145" /><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /></Grid.ColumnDefinitions><Image Width="34" Height="34" Source="{Binding IconPath}" /><TextBlock Grid.Column="1" Text="{Binding Hero}" VerticalAlignment="Center" FontWeight="SemiBold" /><TextBlock Grid.Column="2" Text="{Binding Reason}" VerticalAlignment="Center" Foreground="{StaticResource SecondaryText}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></Grid>
                                                                </Border>
                                                            </DataTemplate>
                                                        </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                                    </ItemsControl>
                                                </StackPanel>
                                            </Border>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl>

                                <TextBlock x:Name="CriticalHeaderText" Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleStyle}" Foreground="{StaticResource AnalysisWarning}" Text="CRITICAL — DO NOT MISS" />
                                <ItemsControl x:Name="CriticalItems">
                                    <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <Border Margin="0,0,0,7" Background="#281A1A" BorderBrush="#58302C" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="9" Padding="11">
                                                <StackPanel><TextBlock Text="{Binding Owner}" Foreground="{StaticResource AnalysisWarning}" FontWeight="Bold" /><TextBlock Margin="0,3,0,0" Text="{Binding Rule}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /><TextBlock Margin="0,3,0,0" Text="{Binding FailureImpactDisplay}" Foreground="{StaticResource SecondaryText}" TextWrapping="Wrap" /></StackPanel>
                                            </Border>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </ScrollViewer>
                    </TabItem>
                    <TabItem x:Name="Pos1Tab" Header="POS 1 — CARRY"><ContentControl x:Name="Pos1Content" ContentTemplate="{StaticResource RolePlanTemplate}" /></TabItem>
                    <TabItem x:Name="Pos2Tab" Header="POS 2 — MID"><ContentControl x:Name="Pos2Content" ContentTemplate="{StaticResource RolePlanTemplate}" /></TabItem>
                    <TabItem x:Name="Pos5Tab" Header="POS 5 — SUPPORT"><ContentControl x:Name="Pos5Content" ContentTemplate="{StaticResource RolePlanTemplate}" /></TabItem>
                </TabControl>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <Grid Grid.Row="3" Margin="2,10,2,0">
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="*" /><ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" /></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
            <TextBlock x:Name="DisclaimerText" VerticalAlignment="Center" Foreground="{StaticResource SecondaryText}" FontSize="11" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
            <Button x:Name="ReanalyzeButton" Grid.Column="1" Content="REFRESH PATCH + ANALYZE" Visibility="Collapsed" Click="ReanalyzeButton_Click" />
        </Grid>
    </Grid>
</Window>

```
